== Printed and corrected costs ==
The complete physical Limited card prints 2 Force to deploy and 1 Force to use.<ref>[[File:Premiere-L-electrobinoculars-hires.webp|Complete physical Limited face]].</ref> The original article now follows those printed costs and uses that existing physical scan, retaining its original-state UID 1_35o. The corrected game text previously displayed there is preserved in full at [[Electrobinoculars (Errata)]], using the existing canonical corrected-state ID 1_35. Decipher’s complete website face prints 1 Force to deploy and 2 Force to use, and Glossary Version 2.0 marks that same wording as errata.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20010817023628id_/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/premiere/light/images/electrobinoculars.gif Complete Decipher website image], captured 17 August 2001; [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]], p. 54, Electrobinoculars.</ref> The original date uses the physical Limited edition’s December 1995 publication month. The corrected article’s “by November 1998” is a source-qualified Glossary attestation bound, not an assertion that this corrected website face was a new physical printing or that the correction was first issued that month.<ref>[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], p. 1.</ref> The distinct printed Unlimited article retains UID 51_35 and its own publication evidence. All existing assets, strategy text, contributor credits and comments are preserved.
